20257.long_desc:
The Universal Arcade Monitor Bracket is specifically engineered for the Arcooda 26-inch 1440x1080 (4:3 aspect ratio) LCD monitor, allowing multiple mounting options into your arcade machine. It is designed to replace a 29inch CRT tube monitor with our 26inch LCD monitor. We understand not all arcade machines are the same, and replacing old 29inch CRT tube monitors is difficult and time consuming. The mounting holes, the cabinet brackets, the monitor bezels, the depth of the screen....all make repairs and replacements difficult. With our new universal arcade monitor brackets, we are trying to solve this, and looking to create a plug and play solution. Monitor Mounting And Adjustments in Existing Arcade Machines
  • Designed for 29inch tube mounting in a variety of machines such as Midway Crusin World, Sega Crazy Taxi and more....
  • Adjustable height settings: there are 5 height adjustments to better match your arcade cabinets bezel and monitor opening
  • Adjustable horizontal settings: elongated hole sizes allow you to fine tune the horizontal mounting position
  • making monitor adjustments from the front of machine are super easy, connect your extension monitor OSD and IR sensor into the metal bracket
    • Please note, this bracket set may not be perfectly suited for candy cabinets as some bezels may make the mounting difficult. Please check the sizes and measurements of the brackets on this page, and check your arcade machine. We also have other mounting brackets where other brackets might be more suitable. Besides retrofitting into existing arcade machines, these universal arcade monitor brackets offer many more mounting options for custom builds compared to the standard mounting brackets. This universal arcade monitor bracket may also be suitable to replace 26inch CRT tube monitors, please check the size of your cabinet opening and compare to the size of these brackets. We are constantly working on improving the mounting brackets and with the help of our customers will continue to fine tune the brackets to match more arcade machines. The Universal Arcade Monitor Bracket is perfectly paired with the Arcooda 26-inch 1440x1080 Monitor. This monitor has been designed with wider front metal bezel to cover any mismatches between the 26inch LCD monitor's viewing size and the 27inch view size of the 29inch CRT tube.
